summary: Braskem S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held on April 27, 2026. The meeting approved five resolutions: changing the legal domicile to São Paulo, aligning a deadline for digital meeting document submission, enhancing board vacancy replacement rules, adding an arbitration clause, and consolidating the bylaws. The filing provides a synthetic voting map showing approval percentages. No special situation event is present; it is a routine report of corporate governance updates. No deal terms, premium, or strategic action is involved.
